theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (RR : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (D Q : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), RR.Represents R → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, D ω = ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ ball y t, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Q ω = (∫ x in RR.carrier ∩ ball y t, (RR.mult x : ℝ) * RR.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ ball y t, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, X ω = D ω + Q ω) ∧ BoundaryVanishes X ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (closedBall y t) → X ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ ball y t → X ω = R.boundary ω
